objective: Freeze the P3 frontend navigation/data/state/responsive contracts, decompose the application shell, and standardize repeated semantic UI primitives without changing domain authority or route behavior.

acceptance.criterion: P3 primary navigation remains exactly Dashboard, Operations, Cultivation, Journal, Settings, with existing canonical route targets.
P3.0 documents frontend authority, state semantics, responsive shell, design-system rules, and explicit non-goals.
App shell is decomposed into presentation components without introducing data fetching or a second frontend state authority.

acceptance.criterion: Desktop and mobile shell preserve the same navigation targets, active-route semantics, safe-area behavior, and fixed-navigation content clearance.
acceptance.verification: MainLayout test suite and frontend build

acceptance.criterion: Frontend verification remains green after P3.0/P3.1 changes.

acceptance.criterion: Repeated frontend state/form/navigation patterns use shared semantic primitives without introducing a second state authority, domain thresholds, command lifecycle, or controller logic.
acceptance.verification: Primitive source review, focused component tests, TypeScript, ESLint, build, full Vitest

acceptance.criterion: Dashboard answers current station status, critical/fault state, core telemetry, active operation, quick actions, and recent events using existing frontend authorities and canonical destinations; it adds no analytics or recommendations.
